_doc: Alternating image/text rows (components/split-feature.php). Rows flip sides automatically as you go down; set "flip": true or false on a row to force its side. 'text' may be a string or an array of paragraphs. A row's button can be a link ('link_url') or a dialog ('dialog', a key from dialogs.json). Give another page its own copy with args.source.
title: Three things, done properly
sub: Everything else we offer is a variation on one of these.

rows.title: Pressed while you watch
text: The mill sits at the front of the counter, not hidden behind it. You choose the stalk, we press it, and it is in your hand within a minute.
It is the only way to serve cane juice honestly - the moment it sits in a jug, it starts to change.
points: Six blends on the board every day
rows.image_alt: Cane being pressed at the counter
rows.caption: Market Row, most mornings

rows.title: Bottled the morning it leaves us
text: Wholesale crates, home boxes and standing weekly orders. Everything is pressed, bottled and chilled the same morning it goes out.
Order before the afternoon cut-off and it reaches you the next day, still cold.
points: Single bottles through to pallet quantities
Reusable crates, collected on the next run
Standing orders you can pause any week
rows.caption: Loaded before five

rows.title: The whole counter, brought to you
text: A working press, the cane, the ice and two of our people. Weddings, festivals, launches and school fairs - the setup is the same, only the scale changes.
We have poured for eighty people in a garden and four thousand at a festival gate.
points: Two hours to set up, one to clear
Power and water needs sent ahead in writing
Fully insured, with certificates on request
rows.image_alt: The cane press set up at an outdoor event
rows.caption: Summer, most weekends
